# #135 - Efter den urstarka sommarbörsen - har septembereffekten på börsen försvagats?

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts look back on the strongest Swedish summer market since 2020 (about +6%) and on September seasonality. Over the last ten years September has been positive seven times out of ten, while March has been the weakest month. They are optimistic about a comeback for Swedish small caps, pointing to SCB-cited earnings-growth forecasts of 40% this year and 25% in 2027 and a roughly 12% valuation discount to large caps. They also discuss Nvidia's strong report and raised guidance as proof the AI build-out is intact, with some worry about purchase commitments and cash flow. The episode ends with a contrarian look at forest stocks after Holmen described the worst business cycle in 30 years.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong beat and ~70% growth guide vs ~45% expected; hosts call AI a fourth industrial revolution, but flag purchase commitments and cash flow.

#### Reasoning

The hosts are clearly bullish on the AI build-out: revenue +106%, data center +117%, a supply-constrained guide of ~70% growth and Jensen's 'compute is revenue' framing. The risks they cite are $279bn in purchase commitments (up 500%+), fast depreciation of components, longer customer payment terms widening the gap between operating profit and cash flow, and gross margin easing to 72-73%. They express no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI/data-center demand slows, leaving Nvidia stuck in purchase contracts
- if gross margin falls meaningfully below 72%
- if the gap between free cash flow and operating profit keeps widening

> *"Här springer man åttor runt marknadens förväntningar."*

---

### 🟠 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as the Swedish route to humanoid/robotics exposure; its Unitree stake gave a ~5bn SEK unrealised gain.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see a big physical-AI and robotics shift over the next 5 years and point to Hexagon as the Swedish exposure to humanoids. It gained from its ~1.2% Unitree stake after the 630% IPO jump. They find it exciting to follow but give no valuation discussion or explicit call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the robotics/humanoid business does not scale
- if the Unitree stake gain reverses

> *"Där har vi den svenska exponeringen mot humanoids. Det är ju via Hexagon."*

---

### 🟠 HOLM-B — Holmen | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Worst cycle in 30 years and stock -45% from its all-time high; the hosts raise a contrarian 'darkest before dawn' idea and a possible bottom in the forest index.

#### Reasoning

Holmen's sawmill layoffs and its 'worst business cycle in 30 years' comment, plus timber costs above sawn-goods prices, show deep distress. The hosts note the best buying opportunity is often when things look darkest, and an equal-weight forest index shows a possible 'fish hook' bottom. This is speculative with no explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if timber prices keep rising faster than sawn goods prices
- if housing construction does not recover
- if the forest index breaks below its recent bottom

> *"För det bästa investeringstillfället det är ju precis när det är som mörkast."*

---

### 🟠 SCA-B — SCA | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 43% from its all-time high and 5% YTD; part of the forest index showing possible bottoming.

#### Reasoning

This is part of the hosts' contrarian look at the forest sector after heavy drawdowns. A chart of Billerud, Holmen, Rottneros, SCA and Stora Enso suggests a bottom may be forming. The hosts say it should turn at some point but make no firm call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the forest sector's weak cycle deepens further
- if the index fails to hold its bottom

> *"Någon gång borde det vända."*

---
